targets.rawSql: WITH lag_points AS ( SELECT exchange, TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(metric_ts, MINUTE) AS minute_bucket, TIMESTAMP_DIFF(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), metric_ts, SECOND) AS lag_seconds FROM `${gold_dataset}.fct_market_metrics` WHERE ('${exchange:csv}' = '$__all' OR exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange:csv}', ','))) AND metric_ts >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 2 HOUR) ) SELECT minute_bucket AS time, CONCAT(exchange, ':p95') AS metric, CAST(APPROX_QUANTILES(lag_seconds, 100)[OFFSET(95)] AS FLOAT64) AS value FROM lag_points GROUP BY 1, 2 UNION ALL SELECT minute_bucket AS time, CONCAT(exchange, ':p50') AS metric, CAST(APPROX_QUANTILES(lag_seconds, 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS FLOAT64) AS value FROM lag_points GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT exchange, CAST(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CAST(dead_letter_count AS FLOAT64)), COUNT(*)) AS FLOAT64) AS dlq_rate, SUM(CAST(dead_letter_count AS FLOAT64)) AS dlq_total, COUNT(*) AS rows_lookback FROM `${gold_dataset}.fct_market_metrics` WHERE ('${exchange:csv}' = '$__all' OR exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange:csv}', ','))) AND metric_ts >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 6 HOUR) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY dlq_rate DESC

WITH px AS ( SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(metric_ts, MINUTE) AS minute_bucket, instrument_id, MIN(CAST(close AS FLOAT64)) AS min_px, MAX(CAST(close AS FLOAT64)) AS max_px FROM `${gold_dataset}.fct_market_metrics` WHERE ('${exchange:csv}' = '$__all' OR exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange:csv}', ','))) AND ('${instrument_id:csv}' = '$__all' OR instrument_id IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${instrument_id:csv}', ','))) AND close IS NOT NULL AND metric_ts >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY 1, 2 ) SELECT minute_bucket AS time, CONCAT(instrument_id, ':max-min') AS metric, CAST(SAFE_DIVIDE(max_px - min_px, NULLIF((max_px + min_px) / 2, 0)) * 10000 AS FLOAT64) AS value FROM px ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cross-exchange price divergence by instrument (max-min bps)

targets.rawSql: WITH base AS ( SELECT metric_ts, exchange, instrument_id, CAST(close AS FLOAT64) AS close_px, LAG(CAST(close AS FLOAT64)) OVER (PARTITION BY exchange, instrument_id ORDER BY metric_ts) AS prev_close FROM `${gold_dataset}.fct_market_metrics` WHERE ('${exchange:csv}' = '$__all' OR exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange:csv}', ','))) AND metric_ts >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ), rets AS ( SELECT exchange, instrument_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(close_px - prev_close, NULLIF(prev_close, 0)) AS ret FROM base WHERE prev_close IS NOT NULL ) SELECT a.instrument_id AS instrument_a, b.instrument_id AS instrument_b, CAST(CORR(a.ret, b.ret) AS FLOAT64) AS corr_1d FROM rets a JOIN rets b ON a.exchange = b.exchange AND a.instrument_id < b.instrument_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY corr_1d DESC LIMIT 100

WITH w AS ( SELECT exchange, instrument_id, symbol, metric_ts, CAST(close AS FLOAT64) AS close_px, CAST(volume AS FLOAT64) AS volume_px, CAST(spread_bps AS FLOAT64) AS spread_bps FROM `${gold_dataset}.fct_market_metrics` WHERE ('${exchange:csv}' = '$__all' OR exchange IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${exchange:csv}', ','))) AND ('${instrument_id:csv}' = '$__all' OR instrument_id IN UNNEST(SPLIT('${instrument_id:csv}', ','))) AND metric_ts >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ), r AS ( SELECT exchange, instrument_id, symbol, metric_ts, SAFE_DIVIDE(close_px - LAG(close_px) OVER (PARTITION BY exchange, instrument_id ORDER BY metric_ts), NULLIF(LAG(close_px) OVER (PARTITION BY exchange, instrument_id ORDER BY metric_ts), 0)) AS ret, volume_px, spread_bps FROM w ), s AS ( SELECT exchange, instrument_id, symbol, metric_ts, ret, volume_px, spread_bps, AVG(ret) OVER (PARTITION BY exchange, instrument_id) AS avg_ret, STDDEV_POP(ret) OVER (PARTITION BY exchange, instrument_id) AS sd_ret, AVG(volume_px) OVER (PARTITION BY exchange, instrument_id) AS avg_vol, STDDEV_POP(volume_px) OVER (PARTITION BY exchange, instrument_id) AS sd_vol, AVG(spread_bps) OVER (PARTITION BY exchange, instrument_id) AS avg_spread, STDDEV_POP(spread_bps) OVER (PARTITION BY exchange, instrument_id) AS sd_spread FROM r ) SELECT exchange, instrument_id, symbol, metric_ts, CAST((COALESCE(ABS(SAFE_DIVIDE(ret - avg_ret, NULLIF(sd_ret, 0))), 0) + COALESCE(ABS(SAFE_DIVIDE(volume_px - avg_vol, NULLIF(sd_vol, 0))), 0) + COALESCE(ABS(SAFE_DIVIDE(spread_bps - avg_spread, NULLIF(sd_spread, 0))), 0)) AS FLOAT64) AS anomaly_score, ret, volume_px AS volume, spread_bps FROM s WHERE metric_ts >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 2 HOUR) ORDER BY anomaly_score DESC LIMIT 200
